RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Foreigner arrested by Japanese Gendarmerie
on Szechuen Rd Bridge.

At 1.05 p.m. 6/5/38, S.P.C.497 reported that at
12.15 p.m. even date, members of the Japanese Gendar-
merie had arrested one Foreigner in M/Car, Lic.No.7142
on Szechuen Rd Bridge and took him to the Gendarmerie
Headquarters, Bridge House, together with the car.

Enquiries made by J.D.S.138 Tsuji ascertained
that one Russian, name unknown, had been arrested by
the Japanese Gendarmerie at 12.15 p.m. 6/5/38 on
Szechuen Rd Bridge for transporting 5 bags of sugar
without first having obtained a permit from the Japanese
Consulate, but the unknown Russian together with his car
and contents had been released prior to the arrival of
Police.

It appears that the Russian informed the Gendar-
merie Officer that he had purchased the sugar from the
Yamaguchi Rice Shop, 290 Woosung Road and produced a
receipt for same. This was verified by the Gendarmerie
officer and found correct when owing to the fact that
he had purchased the sugar from a Japanese shop, he
was released, his m/car and sugar returned to him and
he was cautioned that in future he must first obtain a
permit for the transporting of sugar, after which he
was released.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE - 7 MAY 1938 SPECIAL BRANCH）

一名外籍人士在四川路桥被日本宪兵逮捕。

1938年5月6日下午1时05分，巡捕 S.P.C.497 报告称，同日中午12时15分，日本宪兵队员在四川路桥逮捕了一名乘坐牌照号为7142的机动车的外籍人士，并将其连人带车押往位于百老汇大厦的日本宪兵队总部。

经日本侦探副督察 Tsuji (辻) 第138号查询查明，1938年5月6日中午12时15分，一名姓名不详的俄国人在四川路桥因未事先从日本领事馆取得许可证而运输5袋糖，被日本宪兵逮捕，但在警察到达之前，该不知名俄国人及其车辆和车内物品已被释放。

据悉，该俄国人向宪兵军官表示，他是从吴淞路290号山口米店购买的糖，并出示了收据。经宪兵军官核实无误，鉴于他是从一家日本商店购买的糖，遂将其释放，发还其机动车及糖，并警告他今后运输糖必须先取得许可证，随后将其释放。

NIPPO

SWISS REMOVES SUGAR UNDER CEMENT PERMIT.

A Swiss named C. Gross was arrested by the
Japanese Consular Police for attempting to remove
a large quantity of sugar under a cement permit.
An investigation made into the matter shows that
the Swiss has 1,200 bags of sugar stored at the
Yong Pung Cheng Godown, but only 300 of these
bags are found to have been purchased by him
through proper channels. It was also ascertained
that he had used the German flag in his attempt.
He is reported to have removed some arms and
ammunition to the other side of the Soochow Creek
from Hongkew district. In connection with this
the Japanese authorities are making further
investigations.

On May 6 the Swiss Consul-General sent a
letter to the Japanese Consul-General expressing
regret over the Gross case and promised to pay
careful attention to prevent a recurrence of such
incidents.

瑞士人凭水泥许可证运走白糖。

一名姓 C. Gross 的瑞士人被日本领事警察逮捕，原因是试图凭水泥许可证运走大量白糖。对此事的调查显示，该瑞士人在永丰成（Yong Pung Cheng）仓库存有1,200袋白糖，但经查实，其中仅有300袋是他通过正当渠道购买的。还查明他在企图作案时使用了德国国旗。据报道，他曾将一些武器弹药从虹口区运至苏州河对岸。就此，日本当局正在进行进一步调查。

5月6日，瑞士总领事致函日本总领事，对 Gross 一案表示遗憾，并承诺密切关注以防止此类事件再次发生。

I am George Naumovich Blunovich, 22 years of age, Latvian
citizen, chauffeur by profession, residing House 107, Lane 37,
Brenan Road.

At present I am working as a chauffeur-mechanic with the
Sharp and Sawyer company at 656 Szechuen Road.

At about 5.30 p.m. 4/5/38 I received an order from Mr.
Sawyer to take on m/truck 6 Chinese coolies and to proceed to
the Reichel's Godown on East Broadway to meet our loaded m/truck
and then to proceed together to our godown on Yangpoo Road and
unload same.

I went as ordered driving m/truck licence No. 20174 and met
m/truck licence No. 16309 which was loaded with bags of sugar
and fertilizer. We arrived at our godown which I opened with the
keys in my possession and the coolies began to unload the m/truck

After 6 or 7 bags were removed from the m/truck three
Japanese (two civilians and one from the Japanese Consular
Police) appeared in the godown and one of them wearing civilian
clothes told me in Russian language not to unload the m/truck.
On my question re the reason for such demand he told me that the
explanation will be given in the Japanese Consulate. Then he ord-
ered me and Chinese chauffeur to drive both m/trucks to the
Japanese Consulate and this we did.

On arrival at the Japanese Consulate compound the Japanese
who spoke Russian immediately took from me m/trucks and godown
keys and together with Chinese chauffeur named Zung we were taken
to the Offices of the Japanese Consular Police where we were
questioned.

我是乔治·瑙莫维奇·布卢诺维奇（George Naumovich Blunovich），22 岁，拉脱维亚公民，职业为司机，居住于布伦路（Brenan Road）37 弄 107 号。

目前我在四川路 656 号的夏普与索耶公司（Sharp and Sawyer company）担任司机兼机械师。

1938 年 5 月 4 日下午约 5:30，我接到索耶先生（Mr. Sawyer）的命令，让六名中国苦力登上机动卡车，前往百老汇路（East Broadway）的雷切尔仓库（Reichel's Godown）与我们装载好的机动卡车会合，然后一同前往我们在杨浦路的仓库卸货。

我遵照命令驾驶牌照号为 20174 的机动卡车前往，遇到了装载着袋装糖和肥料的牌照号为 16309 的机动卡车。我们到达了我的仓库，我用随身携带的钥匙打开仓库，苦力们开始卸下机动卡车上的货物

从机动卡车上卸下六七袋后，三名日本人（两名平民和一名日本领事警察）出现在仓库内，其中一名身穿便服的人用俄语告诉我不要卸下机动卡车上的货物。当我询问提出此要求的原因时，他解释说将在日本领事馆给予解释。随后他命令我和中国司机将两辆机动卡车开往日本领事馆，我们照办了。

抵达日本领事馆大院后，那名讲俄语的日本人立即从我手中拿走了机动卡车和仓库的钥匙，并与名为宗（Zung）的中国司机一起，将我们带到日本领事警察署办公室，在那里我们接受了讯问。
